'''Yanning''' is an NPC located in {{Location|Hongzhen}}.

==Location==
Yanning is found at the northern entry to Hongzhen, near [[Gulan]].

==Profile==
A lonely girl, Yanning was climbing in dangerous places because her parents were always away. To keep her safe, Gulan asked Rover to borrow a self-moving suitcase as a toy. The plan worked, keeping Yanning safe. However, Gulan knew this was just a temporary solution, and that what Yanning truly needed was not a distraction, but the companionship of her parents.

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(1st Interaction)
:'''Gulan:''' Hey, kid. Where are your parents?
:'''Yanning:''' It's dangerous there. Get down now!
:'''Yanning:''' My parents are working.
:'''Yanning:''' I always play here.
:'''Yanning:''' Or else I'd be bored out of my mind since I don't have anyone to play with...
:'''Gulan:''' Then why don't we build a snowman together? Come down first. Let's build a big one.
:'''Yanning:''' Well... I guess it has been a while since I last built a snowman... Okay then.
{{Dialogue End}}
